name: panel
description: A live panel beside the chat: what the task is and why, context, done, next, cards, and sandbox scenes (HTML/JS folders), mirrored to a token-guarded browser view.

doneRowMinutes.title: Finished agent row (minutes)
doneRowMinutes.description: How long a finished agent keeps its row on the board.

dodFramesMax.title: Checklist frames
dodFramesMax.description: At most this many agent checklist frames on the board at once.

stripRoutingSuffix.title: Strip routing note from agent names
stripRoutingSuffix.description: Drop a trailing (sonnet/high) style note from an agent's name on the board.

goalLabels.title: Goal line labels
goalLabels.description: Comma-separated labels of the brief line that states an agent's goal.

ticketLabels.title: Ticket line labels
ticketLabels.description: Comma-separated labels of the brief line that names an agent's ticket.

insightMinSeconds.title: Insight minimum (seconds)
insightMinSeconds.description: The workflow-insight frames wait for this many seconds of agent time before they say anything.

repeatMin.title: Repeat: times
repeatMin.description: The same file touched or command run this many times is shown as repeated work.

retryMin.title: Retry: times
retryMin.description: A command run again right after failing this many times is shown as a retry.

similarMin.title: Same task: agents
similarMin.description: This many agents started with the same kind of task are shown as repeated work.

hintTestsPct.title: Hint: tests share (%)
hintTestsPct.description: Suggest running fewer tests when tests and checks take at least this share of agent time.

hintReadingPct.title: Hint: reading share (%)
hintReadingPct.description: Suggest a file map when agents spend at least this share of their time reading before their first edit.

hintSharedFiles.title: Hint: shared files
hintSharedFiles.description: Suggest putting files in the brief when at least this many files were each read by several agents.

hintSharedAgents.title: Hint: agents per shared file
hintSharedAgents.description: How many agents must read the same file for it to count as shared.

hintRetries.title: Hint: retries
hintRetries.description: Suggest checking the cause when commands were re-run right after failing this many times in all.
